column1: # The Rust engine's settings (plan HE1 Task 37, D1805): every setting the House
# front accepts, classed. Columns: name (a trailing * is a prefix), class,
# default (the 26.9.2.8 oracle's; * is chDB's in loams-house-ipc's
# chdb_setting_defaults.tsv; '' is the empty string; - is none), the task that
# honours it (-: none), the construct it applies to (never, always,
# merge_tables, time, time_params, result_limit), and why.
# A setting not here and not under a prefix here is chDB's rule (R9.11):
# accepted at its default, 164 at any other value, 115 when unknown.
# Classes: honoured (the engine behaves as ClickHouse does), noop (the answer is
# the same at any value), default_only (changes answers; 48 naming the task at
# any other value where it applies), refused (164 at any value but its default).
# An honoured setting with a task is honoured except where that construct
# applies, where a value other than its default is 48 naming the task.
# honoured: the engine behaves as ClickHouse does
